scenes.headline: How a flow model reuses its conditions every step
scenes.sub: Why a diffusion transformer can cache keys and values at all
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Stash! An image model re-runs its transformer at every denoising step. So how can it cache anything?

scenes.text: Keys and values can be cached only for tokens trained never to read the noisy latent and never to see the timestep.
scenes.mark: never to read the noisy latent
scenes.say: You can cache keys and values only for tokens trained never to read the noisy image, and never to know which step it is.

left.title: A language model
items: Causal mask: earlier tokens never change
No clock in the forward pass
left.say: A language model gets this for free. Its causal mask means earlier tokens never change, and nothing in it depends on time.

right.title: A flow transformer
items: Conditions blocked from reading the latent
right.say: A flow transformer has to be trained for it. The prompt and reference images are blocked from reading the latent, and pinned to a single timestep.

steps.say: On the first step, the reference image runs through every layer with everything else, looking only at itself.
Each layer stores the reference keys and values. They will never change.
On every later step, the reference tokens are dropped. Only the prompt and the noisy target go through the blocks.
Each attention layer reads the stored keys back in, so the image still sees its reference.

steps.label: no prefix token reads anything after it
steps.say: Qwen-Image two point one goes further. Its mask is causal, so no prompt or reference token can read the noisy target.

steps.label: the target rows: recomputed every step
steps.say: Only the target's rows run again at each step, and they read the whole stored prefix.

scenes.title: Measured latency saving on an A100
scenes.note: a FLOP count predicts each within a few points
scenes.say: The saving grows with how much of the sequence is conditioning. One reference saves under a quarter; three save about half.

scenes.label: of cache for every 1,024 cached tokens
scenes.say: The price is memory: half a gibibyte for every thousand and twenty-four cached tokens, and double that with guidance.

scenes.text: A diffusion transformer can cache only what it was trained never to let change.

recap: Conditions blocked from the latent and the clock
Prefill once, read the cache every step
Half a GiB per thousand tokens
scenes.say: So: block the conditions from the latent and the clock, prefill once, and read the cache at every step.
